cards.title: MT940 statement parser
cards.notes: Only if decision C6 = build. export parseMt940(text) returning parserOk('mt940', rows, warnings) or parserFail(reason) (types.js:39-44), rows via statementRow (types.js:15). Layout from bank MT940 implementation guides (SWIFT handbook not public; mark [unverified] in a comment): ':20:' starts a statement; ':25:' account; ':60F:'/':60M:' 'C|D YYMMDD CCY amount' gives the currency; ':61:' value date YYMMDD, optional entry date MMDD, mark C/D/RC/RD, optional funds-code letter, amount with comma decimal, type 'N'/'F'+3, customer reference, optional '//' bank reference, optional next-line details; following ':86:' (multi-line until the next ':nn:') = description; ':62F:' closing. D or RC -> out; C or RD -> in; YY -> 20YY; non-EUR currency -> amountCents null (as camt xml.js:506-510); bankRef = '//' reference, else the customer reference unless 'NONREF'. Synthetic tests: basic; multi-line :86:; RC reversal; two statements in one file; non-EUR; garbage -> ok false. CORE_ASSETS entry required (test/serviceWorker.test.js:23).

cards.title: OFX/QFX statement parser
cards.notes: Only if decision C7 = build (recommended: drop). export parseOfx(text). OFX 1.x: 'OFXHEADER:100' header lines, then SGML where leaf tags may lack closing tags; OFX 2.x and QFX: XML. Read each STMTTRN up to its leaf values: TRNTYPE; DTPOSTED (first 8 chars YYYYMMDD); TRNAMT (signed, '-' = out, '.' decimal, tolerate ','); FITID -> bankRef; NAME or PAYEE/NAME -> counterparty; MEMO -> description. Currency: CURDEF of STMTRS/CCSTMTRS; non-EUR -> amountCents null. Check element names against the OFX spec published at ofx.net and label them verified only after checking. Synthetic tests: OFX 1.02 SGML without closing tags; OFX 2.x XML; QFX with INTU.BID; credit-card CCSTMTRS; non-EUR CURDEF; garbage -> ok false. CORE_ASSETS entry required.

cards.title: Single version source: npm version updates sw.js
cards.notes: The script reads the package.json version from the root (env VERSION_ROOT overrides it, like KIT_ROOT in scripts/check-kit.mjs:6), replaces `const VERSION = '...';` (sw.js:6), exits 1 with a message if that line is missing, and prints the new value. package.json scripts.version = 'node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add sw.js'; npm runs the 'version' script after bumping and before the commit (npm docs for `npm version`), so `npm version 2.1.0` changes both files in one commit. Tests copy package.json and sw.js into a mkdtemp folder and run execFileSync(process.execPath, ['scripts/sync-version.mjs'], {env: {...process.env, VERSION_ROOT}}): version 9.9.9 ends up in sw.js; a second run changes nothing; a missing VERSION line gives a non-zero exit. test/serviceWorker.test.js:54 stays as the guard. The planner updates the CLAUDE.md release line afterwards.
